column4: Affected equipment descriptions show known ring contributions, including thrown-weapon damage before and after Sharpshooting, weapon accuracy and attack speed, strength, defensive multipliers and supported recharge rates. Combined rings and current conditions are reflected without revealing unidentified ring properties.

Walls covered by a deliberate Search receive a subtle check mark, remembered when saving or revisiting that floor. Examine a marked wall to confirm it was searched. Automatic searching does not add marks, and secret discovery rules are unchanged.

Dew produced by grass beneath you can be collected automatically while your Waterskin has room. Collection uses its own normal pickup turn after moving. Visible enemies stop automatic collection by default; choose Dew pickup settings in Options to allow it or turn automatic collection off. Full or missing Waterskins leave the dew on the ground.

Scrolls of Gathering gather loose floor loot beside the downstairs. Scrolls of Forwarding send it outside the next region's shop, or back to the floor-20 Imp shop when used later. Both are identified from the start for every class. Keys, quest items and unopened containers stay put.

Create a local support report from APD Settings with your build, device and recent loading, input, memory and error observations. Choose where to save it and share it when reporting a problem; saved games and raw run histories are not included.
Old queued touches are discarded across pause, resume and engine recreation. Back pressed behind a menu tap waits for the requested screen rather than reaching the departing menu.

Find tables, categories and public statistic fields with a native searchable menu. Unicode and common multilingual terms work offline; results open existing UIMSD tables without revealing hidden details.

An expandable dungeon HUD shows current damage-over-time effects, tracked HP and shielding losses, conditional future damage and scheduled ticks. Original effect popups can be restored in APD Settings.\n
Both offered wands reveal their actual upgrade level before selection, like Sad Ghost and Blacksmith rewards, without identifying hidden curse information.\n
Faster visual playback no longer accelerates the ambient hammer strike sound; game speed remains unchanged.\n
Open a recorded UIMSD run and inspect events turn by turn with Previous and Next, 1, 10, 100, 1000 or custom steps, and a turn jump. Unrecorded turns stay empty.\n

column3: Examine every item in a pile
column4: Inspect every item in an open floor pile, top item first, with its existing visible icon, name and stack quantity. Scroll large piles and tap an item for its normal description; examining never picks anything up or reveals unidentified properties.
Customize combat, survival, enemy spawning and loot with 18 experimental controls; your selected rules stay fixed for each run.
Choose 1–60 dungeon Scrolls of Upgrade; the normal setting remains 15.
Explore recorded runs, combat events and individual item histories in UIMSD.
Filter records, ask custom questions and compare runs without replacing your original history.
Inspect the Custom Dungeon Rules recorded for each run in details, comparisons and exports; unknown historical settings remain unknown.
Older background results no longer replace a newer statistics view or seed replay.
Statistics display fixed-point values and mixed-scale percentages in player units, and preserve lower-bound warnings for incomplete records.
See the upgrade level of each offered Blacksmith reward before choosing.
Inspect the next Chalice prick's damage and possible HP loss before deciding whether to proceed.
The Healing-to-Shielding setting affects only generated Potions of Healing; other potion and scroll conversions keep their normal behavior.
The About screen and reviewed authored dialogue use clean alternatives when Adult Humor is off.
Custom Dungeon Rules use provisional experimental scoring multipliers for new runs; original scores remain available.
Older affected first-floor saves can recover their entrance doorway without revealing unrelated secret doors.
Quickly resumed runs now use the correct finished or unfinished state when deciding what their shared history can reveal.
Exports of damaged or unreadable history retain an incomplete-data warning instead of presenting surviving statistics as complete.
Item and enemy tables retain incomplete-data warnings when a recorded event cannot be read.
The circular Imp-vault sentry uses the normal two-turn scan interval; existing affected floors retain their saved position and scan phase.
I'm bringing APD's statistics and difficulty customization together for the early-alpha preview. New runs use provisional experimental scoring multipliers, with original scores preserved separately.
New runs use the selected Custom Rules multipliers, with original scores preserved separately.
Every difficulty slider shows its multiplier, and the combined multiplier updates while you drag.
Invalid adjusted scores remain unknown without preventing access to the original run history.
Read an optional explanation of future scoring ideas, separate from the unchanged provisional slider multipliers.
Daily history shows the recorded earned Custom Rules score, preserves original scores and keeps large values readable.
Quickslot paging stays accessible without covering Inventory on narrow screens.
Messages remain readable above the page switch on narrow screens.
Repeated statistic labels keep their own values when two groups are compared.
Hide UI and the menu buttons stay separate on short, resized and virtual Android displays.
A default-on confirmation protects stored dew from accidental drinking; change it independently in Options.
A default-on confirmation stops intentional walking before a visible armed trap; Cancel spends no turn.
Markdown table exports preserve backslashes in column headings and recorded values.
Boss-key pickup and victory no longer display inherited donation promotions; original contributor credits remain in About.
Already-playable characters no longer announce their old unlock requirements; character availability and earned progression are preserved.
The Grudge frequency, location switches and history confirmation now receive touches instead of being intercepted by their scroll pane.
